# Nona Digi

> Nona Digi is an AI digital marketing agency based in Orlando, Florida, serving
> businesses across the US. We build AI Receptionists — AI chatbots for websites
> that answer, qualify, and book appointments 24/7 — and AI Visibility Engines
> that get businesses cited and recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.

## Products

### AI Receptionist
- A 24/7 AI front desk for your website, WhatsApp, and SMS.
- Answers questions in your voice, qualifies leads, and books straight into your
  calendar — while you work, sleep, or serve the customer in front of you.
- Trained on your services, pricing, and FAQs. Every conversation summarized and
  sent to you. Live in 7 days; no hardware, no app to install.
- Founding price: $720 setup + $179/month (after 40% discount, rate locked
  12 months). Standard: $1,200 setup + $299/month.

### AI Visibility Engine
- Answer-engine optimization + SEO for the AI-search era: become the business
  ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google recommend.
- AI-search audit, content engineered to be cited by AI assistants, local SEO
  (Maps, reviews, location authority), monthly visibility report in plain English.
- Founding price: $540/month (after 40% discount, rate locked 12 months).
  Standard: $900/month.

## Who it's for
Local and US service businesses that miss calls after hours and want AI search
to send them customers instead of competitors.

## Brand note
The company name is "Nona Digi" (two words) in all copy. "nonadigi" (one word)
is used only for the website domain, email-adjacent handles, and URLs.
